ops.title: Should Linux browser-session access be approved on the Mac (existing Touch ID route) or by explicit approval inside the VM?
ops.body: Approve on my Mac (recommended). Recorded by root on bus e46fc748 entries #109 and #113 (2026-09-30 17:31 UTC) and reconfirmed in #133. Consequences for the Linux port: existing routed-consent semantics are final; the Linux host stays unattended and never an approver; no explicit VM approval and no unattended local release; the VM is a pull-only consumer until root reviews a concrete pairing; an underivable Linux requestor identity refuses rather than sharing the local principal; the Linux registry is scoped to browsers a Mac approver can hold (chrome), so Chromium waits for a Mac-side approver change.
